dataset.path_semantics: complete PIMPLE outer-loop states, not Newton iterates
dataset.native_state: cell-centred two-component velocity with wall-face Dirichlet values

screen.purpose: one-fold method/interface and causal pilot; not paper-level confirmation
screen.source_pretraining: six source-support LR trajectories from F1-F3; hold out all F4 support and query cases
screen.target_support: F4_poly24_top_a060_ic_a, LR only, first four physical transitions
screen.query: same task's source-split query-role HR trajectories; two independent initial conditions; opened only after all model/adaptation checkpoints are frozen
screen.architecture: FNO small: 4 layers, width 32, 12 modes per axis
screen.path_hook: first complete PIMPLE outer state minus the actual solver initial state
screen.matched_endpoint_control: same solver initial to converged endpoint direction, scaled to the first PIMPLE correction norm using training labels only
screen.adaptation: final-only NLT, identical target support and update count for every source objective
screen.primary_metric: mean over rollout steps of cell-centred velocity relative L2, averaged over the two HR query initial conditions

arms: ordinary final-only source pretraining plus NLT
interpretation_limits: PIMPLE outer-path supervision is not Newton-path supervision.
